title: Bonespike Helmet

sources.title: Fury In The Marrow
markers: | description = When you {{SAI|Rage}}, hostile creatures in a {{Dist|m=3|ft=10}} radius must succeed a {{Saving Throw|Wisdom|dc=weapon action}} or take {{DamageText|2d4|Psychic}} damage. The targets receive half damage on a save.{{see bugs}}

sources.title: Menacing Attack (Bonespike Helmet)
markers: | description = Possibly {{SmCond|Frightened|Frighten}} your target. They'll have {{Disadvantage}} on [[ability checks]] and {{Attack roll}}s and be unable to move.

summary: +2 Intimidation. On Rage, hostiles within 10 ft make a Wisdom save against your weapon-action DC for half of 2d4 Psychic damage. Once per turn make a melee Menacing Attack, adding your proficiency bonus to damage. The target makes a Wisdom save against your weapon-action DC or is Frightened for 2 turns. This attack can count toward Extra Attack.
